balanced_rule: r=w*(G16(w)*d-G16(w*d)); raw candidate correction d; reflected symmetric Gaussian; whole-field sum, not every ROI
scope: factorial stable G4 domain, symmetric weighted correction, structure significance guard; imposed and P-estimated profiles; synthetic known truth; no physical noise validation
structure_rule: max own/Y two-scale significance; retain correction1 below3sigma, smooth to0 at6sigma; no probability interpretation
units: linear Rec.2020 Y/Co/Cg; additive independent Gaussian synthetic noise, not sensor noise truth; fixed spectral profile is deliberately also applied to noise-free controls
